html:
The Janambres were a native people of the Sierra Madre Oriental in western Tamaulipas, in northeast Mexico.

They were hunter-gatherers, one of the Tamaulipeco bands. Spanish writers describe them as fierce raiders who fought the colony of Nuevo Santander, founded by José de Escandón from 1748. Military campaigns against them in the 1750s and later killed many, and the rest were scattered or absorbed. Their neighbours were the Pisones.
sum: The Janambres were a native people of the Sierra Madre Oriental in western Tamaulipas, in northeast Mexico.
